newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rises as NYMEX pares overnight losses.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rises as NYMEX pares overnight losses.

text.p: Brent crude futures, which slumped overnight, reversed fortunes in Asia on Wednesday to edge higher in slight trade.
July Brent was last traded at $19.25 per barrel, up three cents from London overnight, when the contract dropped 78 cents to settle at $19.22.
The overnight drop in prices was led by a sell off on NYMEX because of a perception the market was net long.
In Asia, a rise in NYMEX prices once again led the complex, brokers said.
NYMEX July crude, trading on the ACCESS system, was last traded at $20.88, cutting the 84-cent overnight loss in New York by nine cents.
